name: tr_yaxel
caption:
IF YAXEL HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🦀 Crabrawler: it punches its pincers off, and they grow right back. 870 rebounds in junior college, an all-time record
🛡️ Scizor: a steel body that ordinary attacks can't faze. 2-time AAC Defensive Player of the Year at UAB
🐺 Lycanroc: the Wolf Pokémon backs its prey into a corner. National champ and Big Ten Player of the Year at Michigan
🐉 Dratini: it keeps shedding its skin and growing. We took him at #11
🔥 Arcanine: the fire blazing inside it is its power. 37 vs the Clippers, most by a Warriors rookie since Steph
🐲 Dragonite: big and bulky, and it still flies. 21.2 points a night through 10 games

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Yaxel Lendeborg had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF YAXEL HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Crabrawler. It punches so hard its pincers come off, then they grow right back. Eight hundred seventy rebounds in junior college, an all-time record.
beats.dlg: PINCERS GROW RIGHT BACK!|870 JUCO BOARDS, A RECORD!

beats.vo: Scizor. Its body is hard as steel, and ordinary attacks don't faze it. Two-time conference Defensive Player of the Year at U A B.
beats.dlg: A BODY HARD AS STEEL.|2-TIME AAC DPOY AT UAB!

beats.vo: Lycanroc, the Wolf Pokemon. It backs its prey into a corner with swift moves. National champion and Big Ten Player of the Year at Michigan.
beats.dlg: IT CORNERS ITS PREY.|NCAA CHAMP + BIG TEN POY!

beats.vo: Dratini. It keeps shedding its skin and growing bigger. We took him eleventh, and he's still evolving.
beats.dlg: IT SHEDS SKIN AND GROWS.|WE TOOK HIM AT #11!

beats.vo: Arcanine. The fire blazing inside its body is its source of power. Thirty-seven against the Clippers, the most by one of our rookies since Steph.
beats.dlg: A FIRE BLAZES INSIDE IT.|37: TOP ROOKIE SINCE STEPH

beats.vo: And the ace. Dragonite. Its body is big and bulky, and it still flies. Twenty-one point two a night through ten games, as a rookie.
beats.dlg: BULKY, BUT IT STILL FLIES.|21.2 A NIGHT AS A ROOKIE!

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Lendeborg: 3 seasons at Arizona Western (junior college), NJCAA all-time record 870 rebounds; 2x AAC Defensive Player of the Year at UAB (2024, 2025); 2026 NCAA national champion and Big Ten Player of the Year at Michigan (Wolverines); drafted 11th overall (#11) in 2026 by Golden State; November 1: career-high 37 points vs the Clippers, most by a Warrior rookie since Curry
